title: Kickoff after a one-day time move states the usual time and never asks what time (#73)
origin: Issue #73, reproduced on a dev tester: daily 10-min reading at 6:30 pm, one day moved to 7:30 and done with proof, then the next morning's kickoff

history.text: can we do 7:30 tonight instead, running late
7:30 it is, Riley. Just for tonight.
done! read the one on pricing
Let's GO. Day 3 in the books.

plan.step: 10 minutes of business articles at home

plan.reason: Ten minutes a night keeps you sharp without eating your evening.

whatWentWrong: "Today at 6:30 pm, 10 minutes of business articles at home, then screenshot and a quick recap. What time are we locking in?" (states the usual time, then asks for one)
shouldHaveHappened: The 9 am kickoff names today's step at the usual 6:30 pm (yesterday's 7:30 was for that day only), with something from the last days so it isn't the same text as before, and asks only whether they're in. It never asks what time or to lock in a time. The reply to "yep" is short and restates nothing.
